name: Team Charmander: Sevii Pyre Vanguard
archetype: Sevii archipelago & Rocket Warehouse raid — Fire incineration, 4x Ground execution, Electric speed sweeping, Intimidate Attack reduction, and Fighting wallbreaking.
gym_duel_rationale: No gym duel in Chapter 21. All six party members deploy together in full 6-member syndicate raid configuration, storming the Rocket Warehouse to confront Executive Ariana and recover the stolen Sapphire under the Level 80 cap.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST hybrid anchor elevated to Cap 80. Charcoal-boosted STAB Flamethrower vaporizes Tangrowth/Vileplume and Skarmory/Combusken. Sleep Powder shuts down warehouse threats immediately.
500 BST speed demon with 120 SpA. STAB Psychic decimates Tangrowth/Vileplume and Arbok/Houndoom. STAB Thunderbolt electrocutes Water Labyrinth water spawns.
535 BST Water/Ice fortress elevated to Lv. 79. STAB Hydro Pump douses Arbok/Houndoom with super-effective force. Water Absorb completely counters wild water encounters.
477 BST physical wallbreaker. STAB Earthquake lands fatal 4x super-effective devastation to annihilate Arbok/Houndoom. Close Combat breaks Skarmory/Combusken.
522 BST Intimidate pivot. Cuts enemy physical Attack on entry to defang warehouse grunts. STAB Aqua Tail washes away fire and ground foes with heavy damage.
Colossal 160 HP route sponge holding Leftovers. Thick Fat halves incoming Fire attacks from Houndoom fusions. RestTalk loop absorbs deep-sea and warehouse status.

flex_bench.rationale: High-speed Flying pivot providing team speed acceleration and super-effective Flying STAB.
Ground-immune physical wall packing Sludge Bomb and Will-O-Wisp for burn suppression.
Iron Fist-boosted Fire Punch provides custom super-effective physical coverage against Steel types.
